subject: Request: Sync call to align demo + contract redlines (procurement + security)
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: procurement@blueocean.com, samantha.lee@blueocean.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Sync request: demo + contract redlines alignment

Hi Samantha / BlueOcean procurement team —

Thanks again for the productive call last week. Two asks to keep momentum:

1) A short joint session (AE + SE + your procurement + your security) where we run the demo with a focus on data flow and controls, and simultaneously triage the highlighted contract redlines.
2) A single action owner list so legal/procurement have clear next steps after the session.

Proposed slots (Pacific):
- Tue May 18, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed May 19, 08:30–09:30 PT (SE prefers earlier)
- Thu May 20, 13:00–14:00 PT

I've attached our redline draft and a 1‑page demo architecture diagram for the security folks. If you can share a primary procurement contact + security engineer, we'll loop them in and send a calendar invite.

Attachments: Redwood_contract_redlines_v1.pdf (PDF, 48KB), demo-arch-diagram.png (PNG, 120KB)

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

— Monica Patel
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0199

From: BlueOcean procurement <procurement@blueocean.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: samantha.lee@blueocean.com, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, ethan_park@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Sync request: demo + contract redlines alignment

Hi Monica —

Thanks for sending the materials. Procurement can join and Tom Harris (our outside counsel) should be on the redline call. Security would like a separate short pre-read call if possible — they want to confirm data retention and encryption details before the joint session.

Primary contacts:
- Procurement: procurement@blueocean.com (this address)
- Procurement lead: Samantha Lee (samantha.lee@blueocean.com)
- Security lead: sec-eng@blueocean.com (Aaron Cho)
- Counsel: tom.harris@lawpartners.com

Can you add a 20‑minute pre-read with your SE for security on Wed May 19 at 08:00 PT and then the joint session at 08:30 PT? If SE isn't available at 08:00 we may need to shift the joint session.

Best,
Procurement Team
BlueOcean Systems

From: Ethan Park <ethan_park@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, procurement@blueocean.com
Cc: dylan_brooks@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Sun, 16 May 2027 09:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync request: demo + contract redlines alignment

On Sat, May 15, 2027 at 11:18 AM BlueOcean procurement <procurement@blueocean.com> wrote:
> Can you add a 20‑minute pre-read with your SE for security on Wed May 19 at 08:00 PT and then the joint session at 08:30 PT?

Hi all — I can do Wed May 19 08:00–09:00 PT and treat the first 20 minutes as the security pre-read, then stay on for the joint session. Quick notes for security pre-read:
- Data model: tokens only; no persistent PII stored beyond KV cache TTL unless customer opts in.
- Encryption: at-rest via customer-managed KMS (optional for Private customers), in-transit TLS 1.3.
- Audit logging: API-level request/response hashes with truncated payloads retained per contract.

I have a short runbook and the demo workspace prepared — I'll attach the mini runbook and the procurement checklist (draft).

Attachments: procurement-checklist.xlsx (XLSX, 14KB)

— Ethan
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ethan_park@redwood.ai

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan_brooks@redwood.ai>

Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sync request: demo + contract redlines alignment

- Laura (legal) — can you confirm whether you need an editable redline (MS Word) vs the PDF? Tom Harris from BlueOcean indicated outside counsel will want markup.
- Aditya — FYI I may need a quick green light from you on the executive ask if BlueOcean requests a commercial concession during the call. I will flag it during the session if that happens.

If Wed 19 at 08:00 PT works for everyone I'll send the calendar invites:
- 08:00–08:20 PT: SE pre-read with BlueOcean security
- 08:20–08:30 PT: overlap/buffer
- 08:30–09:10 PT: joint demo + redline triage (AE + SE + procurement + security + counsel + legal)

— Dylan
